body.purpose: Labels, body copy, table cell text.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Uniform soft lift for cards, tables, and buttons.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: Button press transform/shadow removal (The Pressable Rule).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — form submit, primary in-page action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #10B981; color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.08); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.08s ease-out, box-shadow 0.08s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #059669; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #059669; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #059669; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Boxed field with rounded corners and an emerald focus ring — a deliberate reversal of the prior ruled-line treatment.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #10B981; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #D1FAE5; }

components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #0F2E28; padding: 16px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #A7D9CF; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-sidebar-item--active { background: #10B981; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-sidebar-item--disabled { justify-content: space-between; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-sidebar-soon { font-size: 0.62rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #A7D9CF; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Synced/pending state marker — a plain rounded pill, replacing the prior rotated ink-stamp badge.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill--success { background: #DCFCE7; color: #16A34A; } .ds-pill--warning { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; }

components.name: Dense Table Header
components.description: Tinted header row over a dense data table — replaces the prior system's double-rule with an Emerald Mist band.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table th { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #059669; background: #D1FAE5; } .ds-numeric { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
Eaglenet reads as a live operations console, not a paper record: a dark instrument-panel sidebar anchors a bright, dense data surface where every module — production, stock, and the ones still to come — sits one click away. The system replaces an earlier hand-inked "ledger" identity outright; the owner explicitly wanted the platform to read like the CRM/SaaS tools he already recognizes (Zoho and its category), not a bookkeeping metaphor. Where the ledger system earned trust through the gravity of a paper record, this system earns it through the fluency of a well-run console: real-time figures, dense tables, a single confident status color (emerald) that reads as "healthy" and "active" the way an indicator light does on real equipment.

The palette stays deliberately restrained — one accent, a dark command surface, a light neutral data surface — so that as more modules ship (Ventes, Achats, Employés), each one inherits the same console without needing its own visual argument.
keyCharacteristics: A persistent dark sidebar is the platform's spine — every module, built or planned, lives there
One emerald accent carries navigation state, primary actions, and headline figures — never a second competing hue
Rounded corners and soft card shadows throughout — the opposite of the previous system's sharp, flat ledger surfaces
Tables are dense by default: this is an operational tool read by someone who wants numbers, not a leisurely reading surface

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only accent color in the system. Success/warning/error are semantic, not decorative alternates — they mark state, never brand.

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: Every real data figure (a total, a table's numeric column, the Stock headline number) renders in the Readout treatment with tabular-nums so digits align column-to-column. Unchanged from the prior system — a functional property of reading numbers, not an aesthetic choice tied to either visual world.

rules.name: The Pressable Rule
rules.body: Anything the user taps to commit data (submit, save, sync retry) carries the resting shadow at rest and compresses (translateY(1px), shadow removed) on :active. Unchanged from the prior system.

dos: Do reserve Operational Emerald for exactly one accent role per screen (The One Accent Rule) — active nav, primary actions, headline figures.
Do set every real numeric figure in the Readout treatment with tabular numerals (The Tabular Readout Rule).
Do keep disabled/planned modules visible in the sidebar rather than hiding them — the platform's full shape is part of the pitch, even unbuilt.
Do use rounded corners and soft shadows consistently — this system's visual signature is the opposite of the sharp, flat surfaces it replaced.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color alongside Operational Emerald — semantic colors (success/warning/error) carry state, emerald alone carries brand/action.
Don't revive ledger-era treatments (ruled-line inputs, double-rule borders, rotated ink-stamp badges, zero-radius corners) — those belong to the discarded prior identity, not this one.
Don't set numeric data in the display or body font without tabular-nums — misaligned digits break the "console you can trust" character.
